TSMC January 2018 Revenue Report

Hsinchu, Taiwan, R.O.C. – Feb. 9, 2018 - TSMC (TWSE: 2330, NYSE: TSM) today announced its net revenues for January 2018: On a consolidated basis, revenues for January 2018 were approximately NT$79.74 billion, a decrease of 11.3 percent from December 2017 and an increase of 4.1 percent from January 2017.
